تعتنقن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَنِقْنَ (taʕtaniqna) /taʕ.ta.niq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# تُعْتَنَقْنَ (tuʕtanaqna) /tuʕ.ta.naq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
